COMMENT: One V4 Miniscope with head orientation - the simplest config that records something. Start here.
COMMENT2: Keys containing 'COMMENT' are ignored by the software; they are notes for you. Everything here is editable in the app (Setup -> Form), and Reference-AllOptions.json documents every available key.
COMMENT_dataDirectory: Where recordings are written. './Data' is relative to the software folder so this config runs as-is; for real experiments set an absolute path with forward slashes, e.g. 'D:/MiniscopeData'.
COMMENT_directoryStructure: The folder hierarchy created under dataDirectory for each recording. 'date' and 'time' are filled in when you hit Record; every other entry names a key in this file whose value becomes the folder name.
COMMENT_recordLengthInSeconds: 0 = record until you press Stop. Any positive value stops the recording automatically after that many seconds.
COMMENT_traceDisplay: The scrolling trace window. With a BNO Miniscope it plots head orientation; fluorescence ROI traces can be added during acquisition.

Miniscope.COMMENT_deviceType: Miniscope_V4_BNO is the V4 with the head-orientation IMU. Other types live in deviceConfigs/videoDevices.json.
Miniscope.COMMENT_deviceID: Which camera on this computer the Miniscope is. Use 'Scan devices...' in the Devices section to find it - it is not always 0.
Miniscope.COMMENT_compression: Imaging data must stay lossless: FFV1 (lossless, uses CPU) or GREY (no compression at all, largest files). Switch to GREY if the frame buffer fills up while recording.
Miniscope.COMMENT_startupValues: gain / frameRate / led0 / ewl are the values the Miniscope boots with. All four are adjustable during acquisition.
